source: Wikidata Query Service, items stating a GeoNames ID (P1566)
endpoints_agree: checked on one 300-id chunk: both services returned the identical 991 result rows as a set, which is why the mirror is treated as the same source rather than a second one
why: The per-language article TITLE is the key for reading Wikimedia pageviews, which are a measured count of a language community looking a place up. The title is not itself evidence of demand and is never used as such.
known_limit: zhwiki is one Wikipedia for Traditional and Simplified Chinese and this file cannot split them, so a zh count is evidence for zh-Hant only together with the Taiwanese market demand measured separately.
